name: Vectiraptor
sum: Eudromaeosaur from the Barremian Wessex Formation of the Isle of Wight, known from back vertebrae and a sacrum.
holotype: Associated dorsal vertebrae and a partial sacrum of an adult, Wessex Formation, Isle of Wight, England.
material: Only the holotype, found by several collectors including the late Nick Chase.
biology: The holotype represents an adult; all its bones were found within a few metres of each other.
author: Longrich et al. 2022
